authorDispositions.disposition: preferences may define defaults for constructionUnit and presentationUnit, applied only on creation of a new blank document; construction-unit preference in {UNSPECIFIED_MODEL_UNIT, mm, cm, m}; usm never a preference default (document-scoped); no unit preference ever applied to an opened document; with an unspecified effective new-document construction unit any presentation preference stays inert and creates no physical document semantics

no effective document-level presentationUnit while constructionUnit = UNSPECIFIED_MODEL_UNIT; a user preference may exist independently but is inert; never serialize a presentation unit as if it gave an unspecified model physical meaning

explicit constructionUnit = UNSPECIFIED_MODEL_UNIT is an undoable document operation removing the physical construction interpretation and any dependent effective presentation interpretation; it need not delete the element; a valid unused usm definition may stay stored; the element is omitted only when no unit metadata remains; absence of a construction-unit selection = UNSPECIFIED_MODEL_UNIT does not imply an absent element; legacy documents that never acquired unit metadata stay byte-identical with no element
a valid usm definition is document metadata and persists while its element exists, even when unselected, so switching away and back never silently loses it
optional document-scoped presentation metadata name and symbol; neither is semantic identity; semantic identity = token usm plus declared metersPerUnit; symbol fallback usm

usmMetersPerUnit = k, k > 0, finite binary64; locale-independent deterministic shortest round-trip decimal serialization; invalid, zero, negative, NaN or infinite values rejected without replacing the previous valid definition; usm equality = equality of canonical binary64 values; built-in units keep exact SI definitions mm = 10^-3 m, cm = 10^-2 m, m = 1 m; an arbitrary usm factor is never described as symbolically exact beyond its stored binary64 value

a version recognizing the geocedgUnits family fails closed with an explicit user-visible load error on a newer element version, a structurally malformed v1 element, a selected usm without a valid factor, or physical semantics that cannot be established unambiguously; never open with the unit metadata silently ignored; older GeoCeDG and Classic readers may ignore the element and lose it on re-save, recorded as an explicit forward-compatibility limitation; unit metadata never moved into geocedgSpatial to force old readers to fail closed

the source unit context for the AQ-U4 notice is transient clipboard provenance metadata beside the internal copy buffer; never geometry, construction XML, serialized clipboard element content or document semantic state; paste semantics never depend on it (values unchanged, no conversion, no scaling); with reliable provenance and different physical meanings show the non-blocking notice; without provenance paste unchanged, no inference, no conversion

a native dimension keeps a stable numeric model-unit value separate from its presentation text; its GeoText presentation may change with constructionUnit or presentationUnit; explicit consumers of that text may observe the change; a presentation dependency, not a geometric-unit dependency; no automatic parsing of the formatted string back into geometry or numeric semantics; the invariant applies to authoritative numeric geometry, not to explicitly unit-sensitive presentation strings

C may map mm, cm and m to native DXF $INSUNITS values with unchanged coordinates; for usm (no AC1015 arbitrary-scale value): unchanged coordinates, $INSUNITS = 0, explicit custom-unit warning, paired GeoCeDG sidecar required recording at least token usm and canonical metersPerUnit; the core DXF alone stays unitless; D0 records the future contract only and does not modify the G9X1 product, verifier or normative DXF fidelity specification in isolation; C amends the applicable DXF specification, verifier and implementation coherently

UNSPECIFIED_MODEL_UNIT forbids any claim of physical engineering scale; picture/vector export may keep a clearly non-physical legacy/device-scale mode where existing functionality requires it, never labelled or interpreted as 1:n engineering-scale output; IsoABorder and every model-to-physical conversion unavailable until a physical construction unit is declared; no 1 model unit = 1 cm fallback

drawingScale = positive integer pair a:b with physical output / physical model = a / b (1:1 full size, 1:2 half size, 2:1 double size); deterministic normalization by the greatest common divisor; default 1:1; SESSION; shared by the applicable export context of the current application/document window; reset on New/Open; not serialized; not undoable

per-axis unitLabel stays an independent Euclidian-view presentation facility in v1; not constructionUnit, not presentationUnit, not dimensional authority, not export-unit authority; no automatic synchronization in D0/D1

geometryExportFoundation.rule: D0 does not promote it to normative status

dxfFidelity.rule: D0 does not change it while the product and the G9X1 verifier enforce UNITLESS
